puzzle.hint: Allah declares His oneness and commands worship and prayer for His remembrance.
puzzle.arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
puzzle.verseEn: Indeed, I am Allāh. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
